readability-analyzer.title: Readability Analyzer
readability-analyzer.description: Count words, sentences, syllables and complex words, then compute Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade and Gunning Fog scores with level advice.
readability-analyzer.inputPlaceholder: Paste or type an English passage…

levelDescription.veryEasy: Short sentences and simple words — suitable for a broad audience.
levelDescription.easy: Comfortable to read for most readers.
levelDescription.fairlyEasy: Mostly easy going; consider splitting a few long sentences.
levelDescription.standard: Moderate difficulty; keep paragraphs reasonably short.
levelDescription.fairlyDifficult: On the hard side; shorten sentences and simplify uncommon words.
levelDescription.difficult: Demanding to read; rewrite long sentences and add explanations.
levelDescription.veryDifficult: Very hard to read; simplify the structure and vocabulary considerably.
levelDescription.unknown: Enter some text to see the difficulty level and advice.

readability-analyzer.empty: Enter some text to see statistics and scores
